transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... my boss told me I had to come. People at work got scared, I guess. 

I wait tables, and... they said I was freezing up right in the middle of service. Or doing things out of order. Like... I guess I was just standing by the soda station for a while with the cash drawer key. I was supposed to be closing checks, but I was just... repeating table numbers out loud instead. 

I don't know. They just told me I needed to come here.
How have you been feeling lately?
Um... okay, I guess. I don't really know. Just... normal.
Have you been feeling sad lately?
No. Not really. Just... fine, I guess.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think so.
Have you ever felt like you were outside of your body watching yourself?
Um... no. I don't really know what you mean. I've never... felt like that.
Have you had any changes in your interest in activities you usually enjoy?

I guess so. I don't really... do much lately. I used to go for beach walks, or bake... garden a bit. Write in my journal. But I just don't really do those things anymore. Even when my husband tries to talk with me, I mostly just sit there. I don't know... it just feels like I can't get myself to care. Or start anything, really.
Have you been feeling empty or hopeless lately?
Um... I don't really know. I wouldn't say hopeless. I just... I don't really feel much of anything, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No, not really depressed. Just... kind of flat, I suppose. I don't really feel sad or anything. Just... not much of anything.
How long have you been feeling this way, kind of flat and not caring about things?
Um... a while, I guess. Maybe... a year and two months? It kind of started building up around the time they asked me to take on the evening shift lead at work. Just... yeah. Since then.
Do you still enjoy the activities you used to, like baking or gardening, when you do them, even if you don't do them as often?

Um... no. Not really. I don't really do those things anymore. The baking or... gardening. I don't go for beach walks or write in my journal much either. Even when my husband tries to talk to me, I just... I mostly just sit there. It's like... I just can't get myself to care or... start anything.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed. I guess it's about the same.
Do you think you would enjoy baking or gardening if you were to start doing them again?
I don't know. I just... I don't think so. I can't really imagine it right now.
Do you ever find pleasure in anything anymore?

Um... no. Not really. Like I said before... I just don't care about the beach walks or my journal or... any of it. Even when my husband is right there trying to talk to me, I mostly just sit there. I just... I can't get myself to care about things anymore.
Do you ever feel sad?
Um... no. I don't think so. Not sad. I just... I don't really feel much of anything.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

I... I already said. No. I don't really do the beach walks or... bake, or garden, or write in my journal anymore. Even when my husband tries to talk to me, I just... I sit there. I just can't get myself to care or... start anything.
Do you ever feel sad, even if it's just for a little while?
I... I thought I just answered that. No. Not even for a little while. I just... I don't feel anything.
Do you ever feel a depressed mood, even if it's just for a little while?
I... isn't that the same thing? I don't know why you keep asking me that. No. I'm not depressed. I just... I don't have any feelings to give you.
Has your flat mood been continuous over the past year and two months, or have you had periods where you felt more normal?
I don't know. I don't really... keep track of the months like that. It's just... this is just how it is. I don't remember feeling any different.
Have you had any periods over the past year and two months where you felt completely back to normal for at least two weeks?
I... no. Like I just told you, I don't remember it being any different. I haven't felt... normal. It just stays like this.
Do you ever feel a little down?
I... I just said I'm not depressed. I don't feel down. I don't feel much of anything.
